mentions.name: PDF Reflow
mentions.description: This app displays PDFs on mobile while preserving the original look and feel — fonts, formulas, pictures, and tables — reformatted for a smaller screen. It uses a locally run YOLO detector trained specifically on detecting PDF page regions, replacing the earlier heuristics-based approach that struggled with edge cases.
mentions.problem: Reading full-fidelity PDFs on small mobile screens is difficult, and the previous heuristics-based version failed on edge cases that the new AI-based region detection approach solves.
mentions.audience: Readers of scientific papers on mobile devices.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Cooking a local AI version of PDF Reflow to show PDFs on mobile and keep all the look and feel (font, formulas, pictures, tables) yet formatted for a smaller screen.

It’s using a local YOLO detector trained specifically on detection pdf page regions.
